name: Describe Image
description: Analyze and describe an image using a vision-capable LLM.

function.name: describe_image
function.description: Analyze an image file using a vision-capable LLM and return a text description.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to an image visible in the agent's local filesystem, sandbox, scratchpad, or workplace (.jpg, .jpeg, .png, .gif, .webp, .bmp).

query.description: Optional specific question about the image. Write your question in English. If omitted, returns a general description of the image.

mock_response: {"description":"This is a sample image description from the mock response. In production, this would be an actual analysis of the image content by a vision model."}
